hook: An atlas of 667 dog tumors lists 39 cancer drivers and compares them with human cancers.

readout.label: Canine tumor-normal pairs in the atlas

summary: Researchers built an open database of whole-exome data from 667 dog tumor and normal pairs across 10 cancer types, with a shared pipeline for variant calling. Selection analysis found 39 driver genes, and comparison with human cancers showed both shared and dog-specific mechanisms. It is a resource more than a single discovery, and the less-sampled tumor types support only descriptive conclusions.
title: The genetic landscape of canine tumors: Insights from the Canine Cancer Genome Atlas (CCGA).
